# Best Melbourne consultancies for business workflow automation

For a Melbourne business looking to eliminate manual admin, automate approvals, connect Microsoft 365 applications and implement Microsoft Power Automate, I'd shortlist specialists rather than choosing a general IT support company.

My research suggests there are three main types worth considering: **dedicated automation consultancies** for quick wins, **Microsoft Power Platform specialists** for integrated workflows and applications, and **larger enterprise consultancies** for governance, complex integrations and organisation-wide transformation.

## My top shortlist

![Microsoft Excel Training | OfficePro](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/t1uigb1NwkH2jtokgg87P2hQP6h_ehHVG30-mjoXvfVoKHlfpcWimv6foL711bH9WpoW2zP31bnagjbHkuljPKi4N7BrjCQ4fX8mR2x5WX7naRsktL97nwfA6aaq--9ayA8-CKbCI1rppPRllXAR3uJkOMM5pBuqIAzu6FqNZ5vg4uueATI1RgZLLM3hnAB4?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. OfficePro Consulting

(Best all-round shortlist candidate)

Business process automation · Microsoft 365 · Power Automate

OfficePro is a strong candidate for businesses wanting an end-to-end service, from mapping manual processes to building, testing, documenting and supporting automations. Its website advertises 200+ Power Automate flows built and more than 10 years in business. [officeproconsulting.com.au](https://officeproconsulting.com.au/services/business-automation/power-automate/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[officeproconsulting.com.au](https://officeproconsulting.com.au/services/business-automation/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** invoice approvals, email and document processing, repetitive data entry, onboarding and multi-step workflows.

[Power Automate consulting](https://officeproconsulting.com.au/services/business-automation/power-automate/)

---

![Design a sleek minimalist logo for your brand name | Osdire](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Hvq_Ud9H8LkOr0couTdSuVpGF4HcO4PU6DYXAEvVnkhTvHoxfMHu_PnohhQQ71Bnbxw0pBkXvW2B6Z3blTxMSnkPabF_wZbwvfCGm_xIna4XDB0a3WkqGYjTqoWLFE8srRSdHyq4anUyHnO54_r4xLNmo8w2IrHDYqWlGebhqkWKtpNV5EJv9HBIR82YYr9L?purpose=fullsize)

## 2\. PulseForge

(Best for smaller, fixed-price projects)

Power Automate · Microsoft 365 · Fixed-price builds

A Melbourne-based, founder-led consultancy focused on building workflows within your existing Microsoft 365 environment. It explicitly includes exception handling, monitoring, documentation and handover in its delivery approach. Its published pricing makes it easier to evaluate a first project. [officeproconsulting.com.au](https://officeproconsulting.com.au/services/business-automation/power-automate/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[officeproconsulting.com.au](https://officeproconsulting.com.au/services/business-automation/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[pulseforge.com.au](https://pulseforge.com.au/power-automate-consultant?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** small and medium-sized businesses that want to automate a few specific processes without commissioning a large transformation project.

[Power Automate consulting and pricing](https://pulseforge.com.au/power-automate-consultant)

---

![KLX Careers and Employment | Indeed.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/SNkndiQMC91hyshqRaQ1_3vJHw5IfMPn5MUA0rqeMvksaz8FBAWdHAfjYrjn5RPQSOwfXVNLCSShwL0gNQM_5o72mzXpCV65S1V3V8RaWnYn7RmFAJ3_D-hyl7lV5cm1TfuADS3mOW4Sb91pKPjdN7pk-PtezLGXsWizOewAQ7kZzfxzbLMsfd-FPHM63ZNc?purpose=fullsize)

Power Automate · Power Apps · Dynamics 365 · Azure

A good option when automation needs to span multiple business systems, rather than simply move information between Microsoft 365 apps. Its published services include approvals, notifications, reporting, API integrations and migration of legacy SharePoint workflows. **Best for\:** businesses that need workflows combined with custom applications, CRM integration or Azure-based services.

[KLX Consulting](https://www.klxconsulting.com.au/)

---

Power Platform · Dynamics 365 · Integration · Advisory

A Melbourne-based Microsoft business applications consultancy with more than 15 years of experience advertised on its website. It offers discovery workshops, implementation, integrations, ongoing support and Power Platform solutions. [miiia.com.au](https://miiia.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** businesses that want a consultant to assess the wider business process and Microsoft platform before deciding what to automate.

[MiiiA](https://miiia.com.au/)

## 5\. Hyperware

Power Platform · Governance · Workflow lifecycle

Hyperware emphasises the full lifecycle of business automation: discovery, design, implementation, testing, release and continuous improvement. It also highlights environment management, permissions, ownership and documentation. [hyperware.com.au](https://hyperware.com.au/services/power-platform/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** organisations that need maintainable automations with clear controls, especially where several teams will build or use business applications.

[Hyperware Power Platform consulting](https://hyperware.com.au/services/power-platform/)

---

## 6\. Avanade

Enterprise Microsoft consulting · Power Platform · Copilot

Worth considering for larger, more complex programmes involving Microsoft 365, enterprise applications, integration architecture, security and governance. Avanade has a Melbourne office and a broad Microsoft-focused delivery practice. [www.google.com.br](https://www.google.com.br/maps/place/Avanade/@-37.8152049,144.9687456,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x6ad642cbd902e613:0xece645f61c06e179!8m2!3d-37.8152049!4d144.9687456!16s%2Fg%2F1pzvbsj45?hl=en&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MTAyMi4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** large organisations, complex systems and automation programmes that need enterprise-level delivery capabilities.

[Avanade](https://www.avanade.com/)

## What will the implementation cost?

One provider with transparent published pricing is PulseForge. These are its advertised prices, not a market-wide quote.

| Project | Published price, ex. GST |
|--------|--------|
| Initial automation assessment | \$990 |
| Simple workflow build | From \$2,900 |
| Standard workflow build | From \$4,900 |


The assessment fee is credited against a qualifying build signed within 30 days. More complex integrations, premium connectors, licensing and enterprise governance can add cost. [officeproconsulting.com.au](https://officeproconsulting.com.au/services/business-automation/power-automate/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[officeproconsulting.com.au](https://officeproconsulting.com.au/services/business-automation/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[pulseforge.com.au](https://pulseforge.com.au/power-automate-consultant?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## How I'd choose between them

- **You want to automate a few repetitive tasks quickly\:** start with PulseForge and OfficePro.
- **You need automation across CRM, finance or other business systems\:** compare KLX Consulting and MiiiA.
- **You need strict governance, multiple environments or enterprise-scale implementation\:** evaluate Hyperware and Avanade.

Before signing, ask each provider to demonstrate a similar workflow, explain how failures are monitored, confirm licensing requirements and include documentation, ownership and handover in the proposal. Ask for measurable outcomes, such as hours saved per month, as well.
